name: 🎨 Theme System
description: Migrazione completa a `heca-theme`: crate standalone, temi bundled (`grid_tron`, `mocha`, `latte`), migrazione di `heca-config`, `heca-grid-ui` e app principale, rimozione dei colori hardcoded e migrazione del chrome hand-drawn verso widget grid-ui. Completata.

acceptedDecisions.title: Theme authoring reference: how a theme is found, written and overridden
acceptedDecisions.decision:
Source: the old theming documentation file (a planning file, now a historical archive; sections 1-11), condensed, then brought up to date on 2026-11-23 with theme inheritance and the pane frame colours (T567, commit 4d420027). The exact values of the bundled themes (grid_tron, mocha, latte) are NOT copied here because they live in heca-theme/src/themes/*.toml.

RESOLUTION ORDER. `theme = "<name>"` names a theme by its FILE NAME without `.toml` (the `name` field inside the file is only its label). A theme is looked up in the user's folders first, in the one search order every user file shares (heca_theme::user_dirs): ~/.config/heca/themes/{name}.toml, then the system config folder's themes/ (~/Library/Application Support/heca/themes on macOS); then the bundled themes. A user file named after a bundled theme replaces it. Bundled names: grid_tron, mocha, latte. Loading never fails to give a valid theme.

INHERIT. A theme may start from another and say only what it changes: `inherit = "mocha"`. The parent (a user theme or a bundled one, itself inheriting as it says) is loaded first and the file's keys are laid over it one by one with the same key-by-key merge config.toml uses over heca's defaults (heca_theme::deep_merge, the one merge). A user file that inherits its OWN name (mocha.toml with inherit = "mocha") builds on the bundled theme of that name. A chain that comes back on itself is an error, not followed.

ERRORS ARE SAID. A theme file that does not parse, an `inherit` naming no theme, or a circle is reported as a warning card at start-up and after each reload ("The theme `x` could not be read" + the reason); heca then shows the bundled theme of that name, else grid_tron. It was dropped silently before. The problems travel on AppConfig.theme_problems, from the single load (heca_theme::load_theme_checked).

FONTS ARE NOT PART OF A THEME. Fonts are system-local, not portable; a theme that shipped a font family would break on a machine without it. Fonts live in the [font] block of config.toml (heca-config/src/font.rs): [font.family.ui] and [font.family.terminal] with normal, bold, italic, bold_italic (all optional; unset falls back to normal, then to the embedded font: Geist Mono for UI, Maple Mono Normal NF for terminal; italic falls back to a synthesized oblique), and [font.size] ui = 15.0, terminal = 14.0. Reload with prefix+Shift+r.

CREATING A THEME. Easiest: a user file with `inherit = "<bundled>"` and only the changed colours. A whole theme: copy an existing one into ~/.config/heca/themes/my_theme.toml and adjust it. A new BUNDLED theme goes in heca-theme/src/themes/my_theme.toml and must also be added to bundled_themes() and available_themes() in heca-theme/src/loader.rs.

FORMAT. A theme is a TOML file read into heca_theme::Theme. Fields: name; inherit (optional); palette background, surface, foreground, muted, border, accent, glow, danger, success, warning; geometry border_radius, border_width, pane_padding; chrome backgrounds left_sidebar_background, right_sidebar_background, top_bottom_pane_background; pane frames pane_border, pane_active_border, float_pane_border; effects glow_size (none|thin|medium|large), intensity (off|low|medium|heavy), show_focus_border, icon_secondary_alpha, active_wash_alpha (default 0.11), card_background_alpha (default 0.02), shadow = { color, alpha, blur }; floating float_background, float_focus; drag and drop drag_ghost_bg, drag_ghost_fg, drag_source_bg, drag_source_border, drop_target_bg, drop_target_border, drop_insertion; sidebar_label_font_size (14.0), sidebar_button_font_size (11.0); terminal terminal_foreground, terminal_background, terminal_cursor_foreground, terminal_cursor_background, terminal_cursor_border, terminal_selection_foreground, terminal_selection_background, terminal_ansi (8 colors), terminal_brights (8 colors).

REQUIRED vs OPTIONAL. Without `inherit`, set: name, background, foreground, border, accent, border_radius, border_width. With `inherit`, nothing is required — the parent supplies it. Everything else is optional with a default or derivation. Omitted chrome backgrounds derive from background: sidebars = background darkened slightly, top/bottom pane bars = darkened a bit more (Theme::effective_left_sidebar_background, effective_right_sidebar_background, effective_top_bottom_pane_background).

PANE FRAMES ARE THEIR OWN COLOURS. `border` and `accent` are used by every other border and highlight in heca, so the panes' frames have separate tokens: pane_border = frame of a pane without the keyboard (unset: border at half strength, Theme::effective_pane_border); pane_active_border = frame of the pane with the keyboard (unset: accent, Theme::effective_pane_active_border); float_pane_border = frame of every floating pane (its earlier name float_accent is still read, serde alias). Names chosen by Antonio, 2026-11-23.

TOKEN MEANINGS. background = app canvas; surface = elevated cards/pills; foreground = primary text/icon; muted = secondary text/icon; border = default border; accent = active/highlight; glow = glow color; danger/success/warning = destructive-error / positive / attention. top_bottom_pane_background = top bar, bottom bar and pane title band. glow_size owns glow (presence, radius, strength) and is the sole owner of glow. intensity owns ONLY the scanline/CRT overlay opacity (Off = none, Heavy = strongest); it does not affect glow. Both are overridable at runtime in [appearance].

TERMINAL THEMING. Theme terminal_* fields reach the terminal backend through heca/src/app/backend_factory.rs and heca_core::backend::TerminalPaletteDefaults. The renderer uses TerminalSnapshot.default_fg, default_bg and cursor_color (the cursor follows the backend palette). Not fully tokenized then: some host-drawn overlays use policy logic, selection/caret overlays derive from the app accent in some paths.

APPEARANCE vs THEME. Theme = palette and tokens, colours included. [appearance] = local overrides of geometry and effects: pane border_style, border_width, border_radius, padding, gap; glow_size, intensity (unset inherits the theme); transparency/blur controls (transparency, blur, terminal_transparency, terminal_floating_transparency, terminal_floating_blur, background_blur, background_transparency, background_gradient_top, background_gradient_bottom, vibrancy). Border COLOURS are no longer in [appearance]: `[appearance] border_color` and `[appearance.pane] border_color` / `active_border_color` / `floating_border_color` are RETIRED (2026-11-23); a config that sets them is told which theme colour replaced each (border / pane_border / pane_active_border / float_pane_border). Removed earlier and must not be re-added under [appearance]: pane_title_color, pane_title_background; express pane title color with theme tokens.

EXAMPLE. ~/.config/heca/themes/synthwave-test.toml, selected with theme = "synthwave-test":
name = "SynthWave test" / inherit = "mocha" / pane_border = "#ff7edb" / pane_active_border = "#36f9f6" / float_pane_border = "#fede5d" — only the pane frames change; everything else is mocha.

SOURCE OF TRUTH if this note and the code disagree: heca-theme/src/theme/mod.rs, heca-theme/src/loader.rs, heca-theme/src/merge.rs, heca-theme/src/themes/*.toml, heca-config/src/appearance/, heca-config/src/loader/unread.rs (retired keys), heca-config/src/font.rs, docs/configuration.md § Theme.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: The only full field reference for themes exists in a file that is now a historical archive, not maintained (T561). README.md:982 has only a 3-line blurb. Without this, a person writing a theme has to read Rust code.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: DONE 2026-11-23: docs/theming.md is the user-facing theming guide (lookup order, inherit, the warning card, every key with what it colours and its fallback), commit 8d3946b4; docs/configuration.md § Theme is a short summary pointing at it, and docs/README.md indexes it. Bundled values stay in heca-theme/src/themes/*.toml. Still open: compositor-blur-refactor-plan.md:498 asks to remove terminal_frost_color from the old (archived) theming doc.
